title: Fix Sketchpad Drag Performance Regressions
description:
Drag in semio sketchpad is very slow. Each drag tick currently:
1. Deep-clones the entire base design via JSON.parse(JSON.stringify) before applyDesignDiff.
2. Recomputes piecesMetadata over the full updated kit (re-flattens the full design).
3. Rebuilds a "previewFlatDesign" shallow copy even when nothing structurally changed.

Also on drag start the whole design is deep-cloned once.

onNodeDragStop repeats the clone + metadata recompute a second time.

Goal: remove the whole-design clone and the whole-kit metadata recompute from the drag hot path. Use incremental position math: only fixed/moved pieces' centers and the connections whose u/v change (returned by dragPiecesInDesign) need to be applied to React Flow. Do not recreate file blobs or rebuild the full flat design every tick.

Edit semio/sketchpad/index.tsx directly. Do not change drag semantics.
summary:
Removed per-tick whole-design work from the sketchpad drag hot path.

Before (per drag tick at 50 ms throttle): deep-cloned the entire design via JSON.parse(JSON.stringify), ran applyDesignDiff, built a fresh Kit, then called piecesMetadata → flattenDesign (which itself deep-clones the design again, builds a cytoscape graph, and runs BFS with THREE.js matrix math over every piece). Repeated again in onNodeDragStop. Drag-start also performed a separate JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(design)) and a full piece-map rebuild for a "flat preview" design.

After: since drag is a pure translation, every affected piece shifts by the same (deltaX, deltaY) in pixel space. Drag-start now captures a Map<pieceGuid, {x,y}> of baseline visual positions for selected roots + their downstream descendants (dragAffectedBaselinePositionsRef) from the existing node list. Each tick computes visualPositions[pieceGuid] = baseline + (deltaX, deltaY) directly and feeds applyDragPreviewPositions. dragPiecesInDesign + scaleConnectionDiffsForDrag still run (both O(pieces+connections)) to produce the DesignDiff recorded in the transaction stack. dragPreviewBaseDesignRef now holds `design` by reference — no clone — since those helpers only read from it. dragPreviewFlatDesignRef is removed entirely.

onNodeDragStop uses the same baseline + delta translation for the final release position instead of repeating applyDesignDiff + piecesMetadata.

Verification: ran `npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` in semio/sketchpad. No new diagnostics in the drag region. Remaining errors (panelVisibility/CollaborativeKitStore/TutorialMilestone/etc.) are pre-existing — verified by typechecking HEAD, where the drag region already had the same pre-existing `scaleConnectionDiffsForDrag` partial-Connection type warning.
